new_capabilities.name: x402 exact payment scheme for XRPL
new_capabilities.summary: The x402 Foundation's repository (x402-foundation/x402, Apache-2.0) holds an `exact` payment scheme for XRPL, added 2026-07-03: the payer signs an XRPL Payment and a facilitator submits it. x402 is the HTTP 402 "Payment Required" payment standard; the Linux Foundation announced on 2026-04-02 that it was launching the x402 Foundation and announced its operational launch on 2026-07-14.
new_capabilities.key_fields: Spec file: specs/schemes/exact/scheme_exact_xrpl.md in x402-foundation/x402. Roles: payer (signs an XRPL Payment), facilitator (submits it).
new_capabilities.gotchas: The scheme cannot sponsor fees. The payer signs the Payment and a facilitator submits it, so a design that needs the server or facilitator to pay the network fee does not fit this scheme. Read the spec file in the repository for the current wording; the scheme was added 2026-07-03 and the standard is young.

new_capabilities.name: XRPL AI Starter Kit (MCP servers and Claude skills)
new_capabilities.summary: Ripple's post of 2026-06-09 lists the Starter Kit as an XRPL docs MCP server, two Claude skills in XRPLF/xrpl-dev-portal, two xrpl.org pages and x402 support (paying in XRP or RLUSD), and credits t54 for the x402 contribution. xrpl.org's AI-tools page now lists the XRPL Docs MCP server at mcp.xrpledger.ai, an xrpl.org MCP server at xrpl.org/mcp, and wallet, payments and trading skills.
new_capabilities.key_fields: Docs MCP server: mcp.xrpledger.ai. xrpl.org MCP server: xrpl.org/mcp. Claude skills: wallet, payments, trading (in XRPLF/xrpl-dev-portal). Current list: xrpl.org/resources/dev-tools/ai-tools.
new_capabilities.gotchas: The kit's contents have changed since the 2026-06-09 post: the post names one docs MCP server and two skills, while xrpl.org's AI-tools page now lists two MCP servers and three skills (wallet, payments, trading). Treat that page, not the post, as the current list.

new_capabilities.name: xrpl-mpp-sdk (Ripple's XRPL payment method for MPP)
new_capabilities.summary: Ripple's xrpl-mpp-sdk (Apache-2.0, created 2026-08-14, latest tag 0.1.0-beta.4 as read 2026-10-20) is the SDK for using XRPL with the Machine Payments Protocol (MPP). MPP is Stripe and Tempo's protocol, announced by Stripe on 2026-03-18; its specs (tempoxyz/mpp-specs) are CC0 1.0.
new_capabilities.key_fields: Repo: ripple/xrpl-mpp-sdk. Protocol specs: tempoxyz/mpp-specs. Version at last read: 0.1.0-beta.4.
new_capabilities.gotchas: Beta: the latest tag at the last read was 0.1.0-beta.4, so expect breaking changes. Stripe's MPP announcement (co-authored with Tempo) does not mention XRPL or Ripple; the XRPL support comes from Ripple's SDK, not from that announcement.

sources.title: Stripe: Machine Payments Protocol (2026-03-18)
sources.claim: Stripe announced MPP on 2026-03-18, co-authored with Tempo, without mentioning XRPL or Ripple.
